ranked.headline: Computational methods disentangle confounded and sparsely labeled single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell methods address confounding, pseudotime dependence, and label uncertainty in sparse or partially annotated measurements.

ranked.headline: Graph and network models couple omics features to infer regulatory interactions
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair graph, causal, and factor models with multi-omics and single-cell data to infer regulatory and interaction networks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts protein-ligand kinetics, drug-target binding and protein function
ranked.summary: Multimodal fusion and transfer learning are being applied across ligand, target and protein function prediction in recent publications.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models for RNA, gene and protein interpretation and prediction
ranked.summary: Sparse autoencoders and glass-box networks now expose learned sequence features, moving deep models toward interpretable RNA and genomic prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and noise-aware models refine variant and modification calling from sequencing…
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks of nanopore basecalling, variant callers, and T2T-CHM13 reference expose how pipeline choices shape detection accuracy.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics across timepoints reconstructs cell fate and niche trajectories
ranked.summary: Sequential spatial slides and optimal transport methods now enable trajectory inference that jointly models tissue position and temporal ordering.

ranked.headline: Reproducible pipelines package NGS and metagenomic analysis into integrated software
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe Snakemake, Nextflow, and desktop tools that bundle QC, assembly, taxonomy, and evaluation into single workflows.

ranked.headline: Transformer generative models now target ligands, peptides, proteins, and aptamers
ranked.summary: Recent transformer and VAE generators pair property conditioning and multi-objective scoring with structure-based benchmarking for lead design.

ranked.headline: Learning models fuse histology, cfDNA and omics data for cancer subtyping and prediction
ranked.summary: Fusion architectures now combine cfDNA fragmentomics, H&E histology and transcriptomics, extending multi-omics inference beyond single data types.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict methylation, TF binding and regulatory variant effects
ranked.summary: Recent items extend sequence-to-regulation models to personalized diploid genomes, chromatin-structure graphs and long-read mosaic variant calling.

ranked.headline: Neural models applied to nanopore raw signals and genomic data tasks
ranked.summary: Deep learning is moving onto raw sequencer signals and foundation-scale genomic representations, with benchmarks testing which methods hold up.

ranked.headline: Transformer architectures applied to clinical risk prediction and omics data completion
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend transformer and LLM architectures to EHR, proteomic, imaging, and sequence data.

ranked.headline: Network-based integration prioritizes drug repurposing and synergy candidates
ranked.summary: Multimodal and network-informed models now nominate repurposing candidates and predict synergy and adverse reactions from omics and chemical data.

ranked.headline: Consensus and tree-aware statistical tools for microbiome and methylation data
ranked.summary: Recent R packages and methods add consensus integration, phylogenetic structure, and false-positive control to microbiome and methylation analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of regulatory elements, splicing factors and enhancers
ranked.summary: Large functional datasets and interpretable or generative models now link noncoding variants, enhancers, and splicing to regulatory targets.

ranked.headline: Refining genomic association inference under relatedness and locus-specific effects
ranked.summary: Recent items extend GWAS follow-up, fine-mapping, and polygenic risk methods to related samples, EHR phenotypes, and sparse effect priors.

ranked.headline: Sequence-structure models and benchmarks refine protein binding and affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published benchmarks evaluate structure-aware predictors of complex binding, affinity and mutational effects against AlphaFold3 and…

ranked.headline: Software tools packaging single-cell, breeding, metabolic, and tweezers analyses
ranked.summary: Recent tools make established single-cell, breeding, metabolic, and tweezers analyses runnable by others as web servers, containers, or Python packages.

ranked.headline: Graph and generative models infer spatial gene expression from tissue context
ranked.summary: Graph contrastive autoencoders and histology-conditioned diffusion models now address spatial domain identification and expression resolution.

ranked.headline: Protein language models predict disorder, binding, and phase separation
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 studies pair protein language model features with sequence and network context to infer functions of poorly characterized proteins.

ranked.headline: LLMs recover bioinformatics workflows and HPO phenotypes from publications and reports
ranked.summary: Recent publications apply retrieval-augmented and zero-shot LLMs to extract workflow, phenotype, and dataset-usage information from biomedical text.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings guide structure, interaction and allergen prediction
ranked.summary: Recent frameworks pair protein language model embeddings with structural, retrieval, and task-specific architectures for sequence-based prediction.

ranked.headline: AI models reused across protein structure, genome annotation, and crystal imaging
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend AI models from sequence and structure data to variant, genome, and imaging tasks.

ranked.headline: Temperature reshapes non-CG methylation diversity in Arabidopsis methylomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and population-scale sequencing now resolve methylation diversity, telomere content, and pangenome variation at higher resolution.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines link machine learning potentials and molecular dynamics setup
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications from November 2025 present tools for ML potentials, kinetics prediction, and MD system preparation.

ranked.headline: Generative models now design antibody and TCR binding loops de novo
ranked.summary: Fine-tuned RFdiffusion yields de novo antibodies against user-specified epitopes, and generative models now extend to CDR loops and TCRs.

ranked.headline: Generative SE(3) models sample protein conformational dynamics and symmetric backbones
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark nine folding and ensemble methods and extend PAE to ensembles, while SE(3) diffusion models now generate conformational trajectories.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies extend reference genomes to annelid, cricket and truffle
ranked.summary: Recent releases add chromosome-scale references and annotations for annelid, orthopteran, and truffle genomes.

ranked.headline: Homology networks map plasmid, transposon and phage exchange in bacterial genomes
ranked.summary: Large bacterial genome collections now enable population-scale profiling of mobile elements, phage tail proteins and gut viral host ranges.

ranked.headline: Programmable tools for integrating heterogeneous omics data across modalities
ranked.summary: Reproducible, accessible software now packages holo-omics integration alongside single-modality omics analysis for expert users.

ranked.headline: Targeted algorithms reduce memory and runtime in alignment and motif analysis
ranked.summary: Growing read volumes and large-scale motif comparisons demand memory-efficient, parallel implementations of core sequence-analysis methods.

ranked.headline: Machine learning maps microbial enzyme diversity and metabolic capabilities
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models and mining of thousands of metagenome-assembled genomes now resolve strain- and community-level enzymatic and metabolic capacity.

ranked.headline: Quantifying per-gene predictability of expression from H&E histology images
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies per-gene predictability from H&E images and integrates histology with expression to recover tumor recurrence association modules.

ranked.headline: Software tools map omics and lipid data into networks and functional readouts
ranked.summary: Recent releases add open-source analysis modules for cytokine arrays, lipidomics functional indices, and network multi-omics integration.

ranked.headline: Simulations link resistance mechanisms to treatment and colonization outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent simulations quantify how plasmid-mediated resistance, dosing schedules, and resource supply shape infection and colonization outcomes.

ranked.headline: Latent and graph neural models embed single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Self-supervised graph and latent diffusion models now address gene expression generation and spatial clustering from transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Computational tools mine literature and transcriptomes to map regulatory networks and…
ranked.summary: Scalable text mining, transcriptomic reanalysis and regulatory network platforms now make large public datasets directly queryable for network biology.

ranked.headline: Chemical structure encoding and spectrum-level PTM isoform resolution in proteomics
ranked.summary: Modification-aware models now handle unseen chemistries and coexisting PTM isoforms, while protein-level batch correction addresses quantitative robustness.

ranked.headline: Causal network, metabolic and callosal genetic architecture across brain disease
ranked.summary: Causal connectivity, cell-subtype metabolism and large-scale genetics are now being applied jointly to the same brain architecture question.

ranked.headline: Interpretable epistasis, heterosis, and genomic prediction methods from marker data
ranked.summary: Recent work pushes association analysis beyond marginal single-variant tests toward higher-order interactions and direct multimodal prediction from SNP markers.
